ORAL ORDER (Through Video Conferencing) Dt:21.07.2020 Seeking quashment of Cr.No.63 of 2020 dated 16.03.2020 on the file of Sattenapalli Town Police Station, Guntur District, registered against the petitioners for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 188, 272, 273 IPC read with Sections 58,
59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short "the Act"), the present criminal petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1972.

entities.text: Sattenapalli Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the common order dated 18.12.2019 passed by a coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch, holding that "tobacco" does not fall within the definition of "food", as specified under Section 3(i)(j) of the Act,
therefore, registration of crime is not permissible .
Reliance has also been placed on the common order dated 05.03.2020 passed by another coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5103 of 2019 and batch, quashing the FIRs., therein.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the crime may be quashed.

On the other hand, though the Public Prosecutor opposed the relief prayed for, but, he is not in a position to dispute the fact that various petitions filed before this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
have been allowed and crimes have been quashed on the basis of the analogy has put forth by the petitioners before this Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid and looking to the undisputed fact that, previously, crimes have been quashed by this Court in similar matters, however, registration of crime and proceeding with trial is wholly undesirable.

So far as the allegation regarding Section 420 IPC is concerned, it is to be observed that the offence has been registered on account of seizure of Tobacco, treating it within the purview of "food" and thus the said offence has been quashed hereinabove; however, looking to the allegation, the ingredients of Section 420 IPC do not subsist.

In that view of the matter, this Criminal Petition is allowed and Cr.No.63 of 2020 dated 16.03.2020 on the file of Sattenapalli town Police Station, Guntur District, is hereby quashed; consequently no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
